hypothesis: Exact split tables may have useful low-degree Boolean vanishing relations whose shared-parameter substitution is much smaller than arithmetic nilpotency or a full BDD.
mechanism: For each fixed-trace table, form evaluation rows of all squarefree monomials through degree2, then degree3 only under a frozen feature cap; compute the kernel. Every resulting relation is verified on every allowed tuple before substitution.
contract: Necessary cuts only; no local or original completeness without retaining exact table/nilpotency predicate and recovering all original variables.
oracle: Exhaust tiny coefficient cubes and compare kernel relations with literal product/division tables, including all repeated roots. Verify witnesses for every derived row.
falsifier: No independent low-degree relations or substitution fill exceeding the unchanged arithmetic circuit; retire route if observed.
next_after_negative: Native XOR backend or bounded local parity DAG reuse, with a fresh implementation hash and unchanged necessary family; independently verified UNSAT proofs if found.
